Span previews never carry `span_kind`, and an unreadable rules file silently disables local redaction. The `McpQueryError` issues in `registry.ts` are untouched: the diff only registers the tools. - `preview_ingest_rule` samples recent logs or spans and replays a rule for counts - Admin-gated `create`/`update`/`delete_ingest_rule` on `IngestRuleService`, held for chat approval - Local mode applies `~/.maple/ingest-rules.json` before projection and chDB, cached by mtime - `applyLocalIngestRules` reuses untouched AnyValue nodes, so OTLP types survive ### Before merge - [ ] **Env var** · Set `MAPLE_LOCAL_INGEST_RULES` in every environment, or confirm its default · [`apps/cli/src/server/ingest-rules.ts:29`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/de1ae3706b8c3d38b212acadd2fe87dd3deba6fd/apps/cli/src/server/ingest-rules.ts#L29) ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · preview_ingest_rule never sees spanKind, so span_kind rules preview as zero correctness · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts:190-194`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/de1ae3706b8c3d38b212acadd2fe87dd3deba6fd/apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts#L190-L194) `span_search` selects no `SpanKind` column (`packages/query-engine/src/ch/queries/traces.ts:1231`), so `spanSampleToRecord` gets `spanKind: undefined` and a condition on `span_kind` can never match. The tool advertises `span_kind` as a condition field (line 126) and then renders "0 would be dropped" for a rule that drops in production. ``` Select `spanKind: $.SpanKind` in `spanSearchFrom` and declare it on this row type, or list `span_kind` in `problems` as unpreviewable. ```
🟠 Warning · F2 · A rules file that cannot be read silently turns every local rule off observability · STAT-01 · [`apps/cli/src/server/ingest-rules.ts:75-78`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/de1ae3706b8c3d38b212acadd2fe87dd3deba6fd/apps/cli/src/server/ingest-rules.ts#L75-L78) `fs.readFileSync` failing (permissions, a directory, the file removed between `stat` and the read) falls back to `EMPTY` while returning `reloaded: true` and an empty `problems` list, so `serve.ts:433` logs nothing and telemetry a redact rule should scrub is stored as sent. Invalid rules are named by line 61; an unreadable file is silent. ``` Push the read failure into `problems` (e.g. `ingest rules ${file}: ${describeThrown(error)}`) so the caller's existing `logWarning` loop reports it once. ```
🔵 Note · F3 · toMcpRuleError reports every validation failure as parameter: "action" correctness · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts:74`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/de1ae3706b8c3d38b212acadd2fe87dd3deba6fd/apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts#L74) The comment above it says validation failures name the parameter so the model can fix the call, but a draft rejected for having no conditions, or an empty `signals` list, comes back naming `action`, so the model rewrites the action instead of the field at fault. ``` Take the parameter as an argument from each call site (`toMcpRuleError(tool, "conditions")`), or carry the offending field out of `IngestRuleValidationError`. ```
🔵 Note · F4 · preview_ingest_rule's drop and redact counting has no test tests · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts:332-336`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/de1ae3706b8c3d38b212acadd2fe87dd3deba6fd/apps/ai/src/mcp/tools/ingest-rules.ts#L332-L336) `ingest-rules.test.ts` only exercises the metrics-draft early return at line 314, so the sampling, `applyRules` replay and `changedValues` diff that produce `dropped`, `redactedValues` and `changes` are unpinned. A regression in the counts reaches the model and the rendered preview unchanged. ``` Pin `changedValues` and the counting on a fixed array of records through `compileRules`/`applyRules`, so the numbers are asserted without a warehouse. ```

Decode element by element so one bad entry is skipped and named, as `compileRules` already does for semantic problems.
